subject: Contract paperwork choreography — term alignment + capacity uptick
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@brightlane.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: brightlane-contracts@brightlane.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal paperwork + capacity uplift (term alignment request)

Hi Tessa,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're getting close to signature for BrightLane's renewal. Two quick asks so we can route through procurement this week: 1) shift the term to an 18-month alignment so our renewal cadence lines up with fiscal Q1 for budgeting, and 2) reflect the 60% capacity increase on the order form (we've attached the PO and the new usage forecast).

On indemnity and data deletion we have a few internal signoff items — I flagged those separately in the attached PO. Can your team provide a redlined MSA amendment + updated order form showing the uplift, proration for the next billing cycle, and new effective date of 2027-04-01? We'd like to have counters back by Friday if possible.

Attachments: BrightLane_PO_3321.pdf, usage-forecast-2027.xlsx

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Head of Procurement — BrightLane
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@brightlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal paperwork + capacity uplift (term alignment request)

Elena — thanks for the PO and the clear asks. We'll coordinate a consolidated redline package. Plan below:

- Legal (Kimberly) will produce an MSA amendment with tracked changes that covers: term shift to 18 months, proration language for the mid-cycle uplift, and an explicit effective date of 2027-04-01.
- Sales (Marissa/Aditya) will confirm the pricing on the uplift (including any volume discount tiers) and confirm how credits/proration should appear on the order form.
- I will own the signpath and logistics — once legal and sales agree we'll push to DocuSign and share the link with your contracts team.

Can you confirm the exact PO number you want on the order form and whether BrightLane needs an exhibit for SOC 2 evidence? I'll loop in Ben on finance if we need invoicing cadence changes.

We aim to get a first-pass redline by Wednesday EOD pacific.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: MSA amendment — first-pass redlines attached

Team — attaching MSA_Amendment_v2_redlines.pdf (first-pass). High level items I addressed: 

1) Term / Effective Date: Added clause to extend/replace the existing term with an 18-month fixed term starting 2027-04-01. Added explicit language on automatic renewal and how renewal notices are given.

2) Proration / Billing: Inserted proration item for mid-cycle capacity increases and a short description of how credits will appear if BrightLane reduces capacity within the committed period. Noted that detailed invoicing mechanics will be in order form exhibit.

3) Indemnity & Cap: BrightLane requested broader indemnity. Counter-proposed balanced language limiting liability to direct damages except for IP infringement and willful misconduct. Requested specific examples from BrightLane if they need broader carveouts.

4) Data deletion & retention: Shortened deletion window to 90 days post-termination with option to extend by written request. Flagged for further negotiation if BrightLane requires a shorter window.

5) SLA credits: Kept existing SLA credit structure but added a clause for aggregate credit cap per calendar quarter when capacity changes materially.

I left a few comments inline (see PDF) where I need pricing confirmation to plug in numbers (Marissa / Aditya). Please review and send any proposed language back to me — Elena's procurement team asked for counters by Fri.

Attachments: MSA_Amendment_v2_redlines.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA amendment — first-pass redlines attached

All — quick pricing notes to close the open items in Kimberly's draft: 

- 60% capacity uplift: recommend applying the tiered discounting schedule starting at the 50% uplift breakpoint; uplift pricing per token shown in uplift-financials.xlsx.
- Proration: Finance (Ben copied) recommends pro-rating the added capacity for the remainder of the current billing cycle and then starting the new committed tier on the next invoice date. This avoids mid-invoice adjustments.
- Credits: any credit calculation that references "committed capacity" should use the new committed level post-execution.

Ben — can you confirm whether procurement needs a separate invoice schedule for the uplift or if we can append to their existing invoice?

I'll prep the order form and push the updated order form doc into the thread by EOD. Once Kimberly confirms indemnity/data language we'll send to Elena for countersign.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Renewals Lead, Sales
From: Elena Morris <elena@brightlane.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: brightlane-contracts@brightlane.com
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract paperwork choreography — term alignment + capacity uptick

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of items from BrightLane's legal team after reviewing Kimberly's redlines: 

- Indemnity: BrightLane can't accept a cap that limits recovery for third-party data breaches resulting from Redwood's negligence. They propose an exception to the direct damages cap for security incidents tied to Redwood's failure to follow SOC 2 controls.
- Data deletion window: We asked for 30 days; 90 days may be longer than our retention policy requires. Would Redwood accept 45 days as a compromise?
- PO on order form: please list PO# 3321 as the reference. Procurement still needs a separate invoice for the uplift line item — they track budgets by line.

If you can incorporate those items in a counter-redline and send back by tomorrow morning, procurement will route for signature same-day.

Best,
Elena Morris
Head of Procurement — BrightLane
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@brightlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Contract paperwork choreography — term alignment + capacity uptick

Elena / BrightLane team — thanks, all. Quick consolidated next steps so nothing falls through the cracks: 

1) Kimberly will produce a targeted counter-redline tonight addressing: (a) carveout to the liability cap for security incidents tied to failure to follow our SOC 2 controls; (b) move deletion window to 45 days (compromise); and (c) tag the order form with PO# 3321.
2) Marissa/Aditya will finalize the order form with the uplift line item and include a separate invoice schedule for the added capacity. Order form draft (BrightLane_OrderForm_v3.docx) will be uploaded to the DocuSign envelope once legal signs off.
3) Ben will confirm invoicing approach and whether we need a separate accounting memo.
4) Target DocuSign send: Friday 2027-03-05 close of business (we'll start the signature path with BrightLane-contracts and legal).

If anyone has blockers against the 45-day deletion window or the liability carveout for security incidents, call them out now. Otherwise we'll proceed and share the DocuSign link when ready.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround on a tight timeline.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Renewals
